description: Use when you need a forward FX rate. tenor accepts either a period such as 1W, 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, or an exact date in ISO form YYYY-MM-DD. Use an exact date whenever you need the forward for the same day a Guard settles: a period resolves to the forward curve's own date, which can be several days away, and a comparison across two different dates is misleading. Rates are taken from the market forward curve, rounded, and for illustration purposes only — not for execution. Returns: forwardRate (indicative mid outright = spot + forward points), forwardPoints (in pips, e.g. -3.1 means the forward rate is 3.1 pips below spot), spotMid (indicative spot mid rate for comparison), settlementDate (the date the rate is for). Negative forward points mean the forward rate is below spot; positive means above. Example: base=GBP, quote=USD, tenor=2026-12-29 returns the GBPUSD forward for that day.

base.description: Base currency ISO code, e.g. GBP

quote.description: Quote currency ISO code, e.g. USD

tenor.description: Tenor period such as 1W, 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, or an exact date as YYYY-MM-DD

name: get_forward_rate
title: Get Forward FX Rate
